correctness.rationale: For the polar of the symmetric edge polytope, vertices/facets are integer 1-Lipschitz vertex potentials with connected spanning tight-edge graph. A cactus decomposes at articulation points; each bridge gradient is independent ±1, each even r-cycle is a uniformly balanced ±1 word, and each odd r-cycle has one zero and balanced ±1 remaining. Uniform facet sampling makes local words independent, with even-cycle edge covariance (r/(r-1))P_r and odd-cycle edge covariance P_r. With incidence B, edge covariance CP_cut where C is diagonal of cycle correction c_e, and C commutes with cactus cut projection. Solving L_c U=B C^-1 Y with L_c=B C^-1 B^T yields Cov(U)=L_c^+ exactly. Series/parallel resistance and the weighted matrix–tree theorem give pairwise resistance, trace, determinant (1/n)prod_C c_C^(r-1)/r. Taking pseudoinverse recovers labeled edges.
